name: Médecins Sans Frontières Open 2015
information:
Registration Fee:
The registration fee is a flat $15 fee. $5 of every registration will be donated to Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders), a secular international humanitarian-aid non-governmental organization. This fee must be payed via PayPal before the competition. Payment at the door will not be accepted. No walk-ins will be accepted; you must pre-register online.
